theme.$description: Hexcoded — Dark theme. Sourced from @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) block in design-system-final/index.html. Accent stays Tech Green (unchanged); surfaces invert to brand-true black; shadows deepen.

accent.$description: Tech Green — same as light (no shift; brand is constant)

accent-deep.$description: Tech Green deep — pressed state on dark

accent-light.$description: Tech Green light — soft accent on dark surfaces

accent-whisper.$description: Tech Green whisper — subtlest tint on dark

text-primary.$description: Primary text on dark — soft warm white

text-tertiary.$description: Secondary text / captions on dark (unchanged from light)

status.$description: Hexcoded status scale on dark — same hex values, sufficient contrast on warm-black surfaces (Tech Green AAA on #0B0B0F).
